architecture.title: Agent = Model + Harness — the eight components by how they reach the model
architecture.caption: The model is frozen. Four components are always on: they enter the context on every call and are paid for on every run. Skills load on a trigger, scripts run via bash, subagents work in their own context, and a plugin is a hook inside the tool loop — the only component that enforces rather than instructs. The approval boundary sits outside the editable tree, in platform code. (Component list from the Harness² repository and paper; the approval boundary is EXAMPLE design for this course.)
